sample: the 300 validation calibration windows, batch size 1
measured: calibrated range and step from each activation QuantizeLinear in the static INT8 build; max_abs is the largest FP32 magnitude over the windows; tail_abs and typical_abs are the median over windows of the 99.9 and 50 percentile magnitudes; outlier_ratio is max_abs / tail_abs; typical_in_steps is typical_abs / step
